name: Motor-Driven Cycle
description: A light electric motorcycle: its motor produces 5 gross brake horsepower (3,750 W) or less, the electric counterpart of a motorcycle under 150 cc.

restrictions.rule: A motorcycle: a seat or saddle, and no more than three wheels on the ground
Its motor produces 5 gross brake horsepower (3,750 W) or less; one under 3,000 W is a motor-driven cycle rather than a moped when it can go faster than 30 mph
restrictions.citation: California Vehicle Code §405, as amended by SB 1167 (2026)

restrictions.rule: The line is drawn only by an engine under 150 cc, which an electric motor doesn't have
Built for highway use: meets federal motor vehicle safety standards, with a 17-digit VIN and a safety certification label
restrictions.citation: California Vehicle Code §405, as amended by SB 1167 (2026)

restrictions.rule: Riders need a driver's license with an M1 motorcycle endorsement
Riders must wear a motorcycle helmet
Registered and plated with the DMV, and must carry liability insurance
Barred from any freeway or expressway where Caltrans or the local authority posts a prohibition
Kept out of bike lanes except to park, enter or leave the road, or prepare to turn, and off any trail or bike path posted against unauthorized motor vehicles
A vehicle, not property: it can be towed or impounded
